In this review, several issues, risks, ambiguities, and style problems were identified in the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. Risks include relying on the goodwill and reputation of each other to enforce confidentiality obligations. Ambiguities need to be clarified, such as what happens when Confidential Information is declassified. Missing clauses include an Effective Date clause, a third-party clause, and a declassification provision. style issues include unclear wording in Section 1, which could be rephrased for clarity. Finally, the agreement lacks a third-party clause, which would help prevent disputes related to the disclosure of confidential information to third parties.
